summary: The current implementation satisfies the saved orphan resource detection plan: it adds a read-only service-level detector for AWF-managed Docker containers, networks, volumes, and worktrees; returns structured counts, examples, reason codes, classifications, and suggested actions; treats active and completed-within-retention resources as expected or retained; surfaces Docker and database availability problems as non-crashing status warnings; and integrates the summary under service status checks["orphan_workspaces"]. Focused detector/status tests, CLI-adjacent tests, ruff, mypy, broader service/CLI tests, and the full 99% coverage gate all pass.
